title: Leak-Free but Not Loss-Free: research artifact (pre-registrations, evidence and raw outputs)
description: Pre-registrations with dated amendments, run evidence, raw outputs, vendor reproducers and the LaTeX source for the preprint "Leak-Free but Not Loss-Free: Verifying Permission-Aware Retrieval for RAG across Vector Stores and Authorization Engines". The evaluation code is in the wardowl repository, under benchmarks/paper/. Prepared corpora and embeddings are left out: they can be rebuilt from the seeds, and the corpora's licenses limit redistribution.
